lsad_codes: Holds LSAD (Legal/Statistical Area Description) codes — one row per lsad_code; notable columns: lsad_code (key), lsad_description, associated_geographic_entities.
mtfcc_feature_class_codes: Holds MTFCC (MAF/TIGER Feature Class Code) definitions — one row per feature_class_code; notable columns: feature_class_code (key), feature_class, superclass, point, linear, areal, description.
fips_class_code: Holds FIPS class codes — one row per fips_class_code; notable columns: fips_class_code (key), code_description.
functional_status_codes: Holds functional status code mappings — one row per functional_status_code; notable columns: functional_status_code (key), code_description, associated_geographic_entity.
fips_codes_all: Holds hierarchical FIPS summary-level codes and area identifiers — one row per combination of summary_level and detailed FIPS fields (i.e., one row per geographic summary record); notable columns: summary_level, summary_level_name, state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_subdivision_fips_code, place_fips_code, consolidated_city_fips_code, area_name.
fips_codes_states: Holds state-level FIPS and GNIS identifiers — one row per state (state_fips_code); notable columns: state_fips_code (key), state_postal_abbreviation, state_name, state_gnisid.
food_enforcement: Holds FDA food enforcement/recall events — one row per recall/event (event_id/recall_number); notable columns: event_id, recall_number, classification, report_date, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, postal_code, city, state, recalling_firm, distribution_pattern, voluntary_mandated, reason_for_recall, status, product_type, product_description, product_quantity, address_1, address_2, country, code_info, more_code_info, initial_firm_notification.
food_events: Holds reported food adverse events — one row per report_number; notable columns: report_number (key), date_created, date_started, reactions, outcomes, products_brand_name, products_industry_code, products_industry_name, products_role, consumer_gender, consumer_age, consumer_age_unit.
locations: Holds FDIC branch/location records — one row per branch (fdic_certificate_number + branch_number/branch_fdic_uninum); notable columns: fdic_certificate_number, branch_number, branch_fdic_uninum, institution_name, branch_name, main_office, branch_address, address components (branch_city, zip_code, branch_county, county_fips_code, state, state_name), institution_class, fdic_uninum, date_established, last_updated, service_type, cbsa and csa identifiers/names (cbsa_fips_code, cbsa_name, cbsa_division_fips_code, cbsa_division_name, cbsa_metro_fips_code, cbsa_metro_name, csa_fips_code, csa_name), cbsa flags, internal identifiers.
institutions: Holds FDIC institution-level records — one row per institution (fdic_certificate_number/fdic_id); notable columns: fdic_certificate_number, fdic_id, institution_name, address, city, state_name, county_fips_code, county_name, total_assets, total_deposits, equity_capital, bank_charter_class, occ_charter, chartering_agency, conservatorship, active, denovo_institute, established_date, effective_date, end_effective_date, docket, change_code_1 through change_code_15, last_updated, fdic_geo_region, fdic_supervisory_region, category_code.
blockgroups_<N>: Holds census blockgroup geometries and identifiers for a specific partition N — one row per block group (geo_id); notable columns: geo_id (key), state_fips_code, county_fips_code, tract_ce, blockgroup_ce, lsad_name, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom, blockgroup_geom.
us_blockgroups_national: Holds national census blockgroup geometries and identifiers — one row per block group (geo_id); notable columns: geo_id (key), state_fips_code, state_name, county_fips_code, county_name, tract_ce, blockgroup_ce, lsad_name, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom, blockgroup_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
coastline: Holds coastline features; one row per coastline feature (grain = coastline feature) with keys/measures: name, coastline_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
csa: Holds combined statistical area (CSA) geographies; one row per CSA (grain = CSA) with keys/measures: geo_id, csa_code, name, lsad_name, msa_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom, csa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
railways: Holds railway features; one row per railway feature (grain = railway feature) with keys/measures: geo_id, full_name, mtfcc_feature_class_code, railway_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
cbsa: Holds core-based statistical area (CBSA) geographies; one row per CBSA (grain = CBSA) with keys/measures: geo_id, csa_geo_id, cbsa_fips_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, msa_indicator, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, cbsa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_counties: Holds adjacency lists for counties; one row per county (grain = county) with keys/measures: county, state, county_fips_code, neighbors, neighbors_state, neighbors_fips_code.
counties: Holds county geographies and identifiers; one row per county (grain = county) with keys/measures: geo_id, state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, county_name, lsad_name, lsad_code, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, csa_fips_code, cbsa_fips_code, met_div_fips_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, county_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_states: Holds adjacency lists for states; one row per state (grain = state) with keys/measures: state, state_name, state_fips_code, neighbors_state, neighbors_fips_code.
metropolitan_divisions: Holds metropolitan division geographies; one row per metropolitan division (grain = metdiv) with keys/measures: geo_id, csa_code, cbsa_code, metdiv_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, metdiv_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
states: Holds state geographies and identifiers; one row per state (grain = state) with keys/measures: geo_id, region_code, division_code, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state, state_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, state_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
cnecta: Holds combined nonmetropolitan economic travel areas (CNECTA) geographies; one row per CNECTA (grain = CNECTA) with keys/measures: geo_id, cnecta_fips_code, name, name_lsad, lsad, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, cnecta_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
congress_district_<N>: Holds congressional district geographies for a state (N indicates state-specific table); one row per district (grain = congressional district) with keys/measures: geo_id, state_fips_code, district_fips_code, lsad_name, lsad_code, congress_session, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, district_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
zip_codes: Holds ZIP code geographies and attributes; one row per ZIP code area (grain = ZIP code) with keys/measures: zip_code, city, county, state_fips_code, state_code, state_name, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom, zip_code_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
nws_forecast_regions: Holds National Weather Service forecast region records; one row per forecast region (grain: region) with keys/identifiers state, cwa, zone, state_zone, shortname, name and location/geometry fields lon, lat, shape_geometry plus time_zone, fe_area.
urban_areas: Holds urban area geography records; one row per urban area (grain: urban area) with identifiers geo_id, urban_area_code, name, lsad_name and classification codes area_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, type, functional_status, size measures area_land_meters, area_water_meters, spatial points internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom and geometry urban_area_geom (partitioning fields PARTITION, CLUSTER).
national_outline: Holds national outline geometries; one row per outline feature (grain: outline feature) with geometry us_outline_geom and identifiers aff_geo_id, geo_id, name.
